description: This file defines a Slack message handler with debouncing logic, message processing, and message dispatching for Slack inbound events within a monitoring context.

methods.name: resolveSlackSenderId
methods.description: Resolves the sender ID from a Slack message, prioritizing user, then bot ID.

methods.name: isSlackDirectMessageChannel
methods.description: Checks if a channel ID corresponds to a direct message channel (starts with 'D').

methods.name: isTopLevelSlackMessage
methods.description: Determines if a Slack message is a top-level message (not part of a thread).

methods.name: buildTopLevelSlackConversationKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key for top-level Slack conversations based on account, channel, and sender.

methods.name: shouldDebounceSlackMessage
methods.description: Decides whether a Slack message should be debounced based on its content and configuration.

methods.name: buildSeenMessageKey
methods.description: Creates a key to track if a message has been seen, based on channel and timestamp.

methods.name: buildSlackDebounceKey
methods.description: Builds a debounce key for Slack messages, considering thread, message, and sender.

methods.name: createSlackMessageHandler
methods.description: Factory function that creates a Slack message handler with debouncing, message processing, and dispatch logic.
